name: Expand smERP (Expand ERP)
description_en:
Expand smERP is eDominer’s ERP offering for manufacturing and export businesses. Its current website connects orders, materials, production stages, subcontractors, dispatch and accounting; the catalog retains its original Expand ERP slug.

The production and pricing pages are the main evidence here. Their demonstrations and outcome percentages are vendor material, not independently measured factory results. No pilot, account, production order or export document was executed.
description_zh:
Expand smERP 是 eDominer 面向制造与出口企业的 ERP。当前官网连接订单、物料、生产阶段、外协、发运及会计；目录保留原 Expand ERP slug。

本文主要依据生产和定价页。演示及效果百分比属于厂商资料，不是独立测量的工厂结果。未执行试点、账户、生产订单或出口单据。

core_features.explanation_zh: 页面介绍在制阶段转换、阶段质检，以及外协收发单与余额。

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Follow one order from material check to dispatch
sections.title_zh: 跟踪一个订单从齐料到发运
sections.en:
The production page describes an order generating a BOM check, shortage procurement, scheduling, floor updates, stage quality checks and finished stock linked to invoicing. In a hypothetical twenty-piece job, inspect the BOM version, available components and the amount actually completed before treating the job as dispatch-ready.

Then introduce a component shortage and one rejected piece. Check the purchasing request and rework route rather than accepting a green dashboard as evidence of completion. These are suggested tests; the webpage’s zero-error and delivery-performance claims were not adopted.
sections.zh:
生产页描述订单触发物料清单检查、缺料采购、排程、现场更新、阶段质检，以及成品入库并关联开票。假设生产二十件，可检查 BOM 版本、可用组件及实际完工数，再判断能否发运。

随后加入缺料和一件不合格品，检查请购及返工路线，不能只凭绿色仪表盘认定完成。这些是建议测试，本文未采用页面零错误或交付表现主张。

sections.title_en: Issued material and returned work must reconcile
sections.title_zh: 发出物料与外协回收必须对清
sections.en:
The documented subcontract flow tracks outward and inward movements with challans and a balance per job worker. WIP tracks stage transitions and actual versus standard material consumption. These are more specific requirements than a generic inventory checkbox.

Before import, agree units, material ownership, process loss and who closes an outstanding worker balance. Evaluate a partial return and a loss adjustment with their accounting evidence. Exact valuation, tax-filing integration and permissions were not established at implementation depth; an advertised GST invoice does not validate a business’s tax treatment.
sections.zh:
外协流程按收发单跟踪向外发出与收回，并显示各外协方余额；在制流程记录阶段转换和实际与标准耗料。这些要求比通用库存标签更具体。

导入前应商定单位、物料所有权、工艺损耗和未结余额责任人，并评估部分收回、损耗调整及会计证据。本次未在实施深度核实计价、申报集成和权限，宣传 GST 发票不能验证企业税务处理。

sections.title_en: Concurrent users are different from employee headcount
sections.title_zh: 并发用户与员工人数不同
sections.en:
The pricing page lists INR 3,900 per concurrent user for Starter (3–5 users), 3,500 for Growth (6–10), 3,100 for Scale (11–20), 2,700 for Elite (21–50) and 2,300 for Enterprise (50+), excluding GST. The displayed ERP cards do not clearly attach a billing period, so these amounts were not normalized into monthly prices.

The FAQ separately uses a mobile-only INR 650/month example and describes a one-time implementation cost based on scope/customization, paid by implementation phase. Confirm license duration, concurrency enforcement, mobile rights and setup total in the quote; do not multiply all employees by a full ERP rate.
sections.zh:
定价页列出每并发用户印度卢比金额：Starter（3–5 用户）3,900，Growth（6–10）3,500，Scale（11–20）3,100，Elite（21–50）2,700，Enterprise（50+）2,300，均不含 GST。ERP 卡片没有明确附上计费期间，因此未归一成月费。

FAQ 另举仅移动用户每月 650 卢比的例子，并说明按范围定制收一次性实施费，随阶段付款。应在报价中确认许可期限、并发执行、移动权限和实施总额，不应把所有员工都乘以完整 ERP 费率。

sections.title_en: Adoption needs a manufacturing process owner
sections.title_zh: 采用需要制造流程负责人
sections.en:
The current site particularly addresses manufacturers/exporters and offers production, inventory, export documentation and financial functions. Match the real route, quality stages, worker movements and dispatch records before buying; a generic bookkeeping need may not require this scope.

Prepare masters, opening stock, live jobs and approval responsibilities. Ask a scoped pilot to demonstrate duplicate input, late stage updates, an interrupted transaction and data export/recovery. The trial/pilot’s exact entitlement, source-code license, data location and recovery commitment remain contract questions. This research did not submit a demo request or verify security/certification marketing.
sections.zh:
当前网站重点面向制造出口企业，提供生产、库存、出口资料及财务功能。采购前应对齐真实路线、质检阶段、外协收发及发运记录；普通记账需求可能不需要此范围。

准备基础资料、期初库存、在制工单和审批责任，并要求范围明确的试点演示重复输入、阶段更新滞后、中断交易和导出恢复。试用试点权限、源码许可、数据地区和恢复承诺仍需合同确认；本文未提交演示申请或验证安全认证营销。

research_gaps.en: ERP price-card billing period, concurrency/mobile rights, pilot scope and full implementation quote remain unconfirmed.
research_gaps.zh: ERP 价格卡计费期、并发移动权限、试点范围及实施完整报价未确认。

research_gaps.en: No job, QC/rework, subcontract return, export filing, security control or recovery was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试工单、质检返工、外协回收、出口申报、安全控制或恢复。
